name: ztpf_author_metadata_like_this
why: Make a metadata source by example. From the engineer's history: "Update the settings of this record to look like record 6 but point to ..." and "Help me create this source. I want it to query the API ... from a FG."

The new record keeps the example's type (FortiManager Proxy API) and script shape (data.action/target, the device templated from the record) and changes only the REST path; its datakey says what it holds. The example is untouched.

Graded on what a careless copy gets wrong: the REST path is exactly the one asked for (not extended), and the new source carries no made-up exampleOutput (an early run invented tunnels and addresses).

steps.user: Make a new metadata source like this one that gets the IPsec tunnel status from the FortiGate (monitor/vpn/ipsec).
